title: Does Coffee Stunt Your Growth?
character: Full-body model sheet, front standing pose, plain white background, bold flat comic-style illustration with clean thick dark outlines, a friendly 17-year-old young guy with neat wavy brown hair and an open smile, wearing a royal blue crewneck tee, dark charcoal straight-cut pants, and clean white sneakers with dark navy laces, clean graphic art, warm and welcoming look.
voice: bright, friendly, warm, educational, and brisk, conversational science explainer cadence

scenes.vo: Have you ever wondered if coffee really stunts your growth?

figures.pose: Full body front view, character looking curious and slightly worried, holding a steaming coffee mug in one hand, standing next to a height ruler

icons.prompt: Bold flat comic style icon of a hot white ceramic mug filled with rich brown coffee and curling steam, solid bright colors, dark outline
icons.label: Coffee

scenes.vo: First off, that old idea is actually a myth.

figures.pose: Full body front view, character smiling cheerfully with palms out and head tilted, standing tall and relaxed next to the height ruler

icons.prompt: Bold flat comic style bright red circular prohibition sign with a diagonal slash through a coffee mug, dark outline, clean graphic
icons.label: Myth

scenes.vo: Studies have not found that coffee makes people shorter.

figures.pose: Full body front view, character on the left holding an iced coffee, calm smile
figures.label: Coffee Drinker

figures.pose: Full body front view, same character duplicate on the right holding a glass of water, matching calm smile
figures.label: Non-Drinker

scenes.vo: The real problem is what caffeine does to sleep.

figures.pose: Full body front view, character looking exhausted with slight dark circles under eyes, slouching slightly, holding a glowing digital alarm clock showing midnight
figures.label: Tired

icons.prompt: Bold flat comic style icon of a bright golden crescent moon with three dark purple ZZZ letters, dark outline
icons.label: Sleep

scenes.vo: Caffeine can linger in your body for five hours.
scenes.photo: Clean 3D medical visualization of a stylized glowing human bloodstream and nervous system, showing microscopic caffeine molecules drifting along illuminated blood vessels in soft warm amber light, clean dark gradient background, scientific illustration, high detail.

scenes.vo: Having it late makes falling into deep sleep harder.

figures.pose: Full body front view, character wearing cozy dark navy pajamas, looking restless with open frustrated eyes, tapping his foot next to a ruler
figures.label: 11:00 PM

icons.prompt: Bold flat comic style icon of a bright red ringing twin-bell alarm clock, clean thick outlines
icons.label: Restless

scenes.vo: Growing teens actually need eight to ten hours nightly.
scenes.photo: Warm cinematic photograph of a comfortable modern bedroom at night, a cozy made bed with soft layered blankets and fluffy pillows, warm bedside lamp glow, peaceful quiet atmosphere, realistic photography, no people.

scenes.vo: Experts suggest keeping caffeine under one hundred milligrams daily.

figures.pose: Full body front view, character standing proudly, holding one single standard small ceramic coffee cup with an OK gesture, happy confident expression
figures.label: 1 Cup Max

icons.prompt: Bold flat comic style bright green checkmark badge icon with dark outlines, solid saturated green and yellow
icons.label: 100 mg Limit

scenes.vo: So how tall will you reach with good habits?

figures.pose: Full body front view, character looking upward with an excited confident smile as the ruler ticks upward, posture perfectly upright
figures.label: Potential
